```{r}
trait.pal <- c(
```

# Load predicted values

```{r load_pred}
scenarios <- c("wBP","acBP","acAllBP","nursBP")
p2fs <- here("output","genom_pred",paste0("observed-vs-predicted_",scenarios,"_GBLUP.rds"))
file.mtime(p2fs)
names(p2fs) <- scenarios
all.pred <- map(p2fs, readRDS) 
#ap(all.pred)
```



# Obs: pred by scenario

Conceive one color scale to apply to all the plots:

## wBP

```{r wBP-plot-res}
BP.lvls <- c("NUR","MN","ND","SD","MT") 

cols <- c("MN"="#7a0019","ND"="#2E8B57","SD"="#3A5FCD","MT"="#bd9b04",
          "OTHER"="grey50","AAFC-CA"="#43AABA","PRIVATE"="#8A42C9")
#ap(all.pred$wBP)
wBP <- bind_rows(all.pred$wBP, .id="BP") |> 
  mutate(rep=as.character(rep))
table(wBP$trainSetBP)
ggplot(wBP, aes(x=obs, y=pred))+
  facet_grid(trait~trainSetBP, scales="free")+
  geom_point(size=0.5, alpha=0.5)+
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, color="grey80", linewidth=0.5)+
  theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  stat_cor(method="pearson", size=3, aes(label=after_stat(r.label)), color="grey30", geom="label")+
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank())
ggsave(here("output","figures","GP-obs-vs-pred_wBP.png"),width=7,height=5,scale=0.85)
```




## acBP

```{r acBP_res}
acBP <- bind_rows(all.pred$acBP) |> 
  rename(validSetBP=BP) |> 
  mutate(trainSetBP=factor(trainSetBP, levels=BP.lvls),
         validSetBP=factor(validSetBP, levels=BP.lvls),
         trait=factor(trait, levels=traits))
## full results
p.acBP <- acBP |> 
  filter(!trainSetBP %in% "NUR" & !validSetBP %in% "NUR") |> 
  droplevels() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=obs, y=pred, color=trainSetBP))+
  facet_grid(trait~validSetBP, scales="free", labeller=label_both)+
  geom_point(size=0.5, alpha=0.5)+
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, color="grey80", linewidth=0.5)+
  theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  scale_color_manual(values=cols)+
  guides(color=guide_legend(title="Training set", override.aes = list(alpha=1, size=2)))+
  stat_cor(method="pearson", size=3, aes(label=after_stat(r.label)), color="grey30", geom="label")+
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank())
plot(p.acBP)
ggsave(here("output","figures","GP-obs-vs-pred_acBP.png"),width=7,height=5,scale=0.85)
#ggsave(here("output","figures","GP-heatmap_acBP-corP_all.png"),width=7,height=4,scale=0.85)

## only with NURSERY as training set
p.acBP.nur <- acBP |> 
  filter(trainSetBP == "NUR") |> 
  droplevels() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=obs, y=pred))+
  facet_grid(trait~validSetBP, scales="free")+
  geom_point(size=0.5, alpha=0.5)+
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, color="grey80", linewidth=0.5)+
  theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  stat_cor(method="pearson", size=3, aes(label=after_stat(r.label)), color="grey30", geom="label")+
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank())
plot(p.acBP.nur)
ggsave(here("output","figures","GP-obs-vs-pred_wholeNUR.png"),width=7,height=5,scale=0.85)
```

Check the change of ranking of the predicted values when changing the training set?

```{r}
acBP |> 
  filter(!trainSetBP %in% "NUR" & !validSetBP %in% "NUR") |> 
  group_by(GID, trait, validSetBP, obs) |> 
  summarize(pred=mean(pred), .groups="drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x=obs, y=pred, color=validSetBP))+
  geom_point(size=0.5, alpha=0.5)+
  facet_wrap(~trait)+
  stat_cor(method="pearson", size=3, aes(label=after_stat(r.label)),geom="label")
```

# Predictive ability by breeding cohort for NUR-all

Get the genotype information = breeding cohort
```{r}

p2f <- here("data","inputs_GP_BP_FHB.rds")
dat <- readRDS(p2f)
geno.info <- dat$geno.info
purrr::map_dbl(geno.info, n_distinct)
```



```{r}
NUR <- acBP |> filter(trainSetBP %in% "NUR") |> 
  left_join(geno.info |> select(GID, firstYear), by="GID")
## NUR-all predictive ability
PA.NUR.all <- NUR |> group_by(trait, validSetBP) |> 
  summarize(corP=round(cor(obs,pred),3), n=n(), .groups="drop") |>
  mutate(param=validSetBP)
PA.NUR.co <- NUR |> group_by(trait, validSetBP, firstYear) |> 
  summarize(corP=round(cor(obs,pred),3), n=n(), .groups="drop") |> 
  filter(n > 30) |> mutate(param=paste0("BP-",firstYear))
PA.NUR <- bind_rows(PA.NUR.all, PA.NUR.co) 

```


```{r}
cols.tmp <- c("MN"="#7a0019","ND"="#2E8B57","SD"="#3A5FCD","MT"="#bd9b04")
cols.tmp <- c(cols.tmp, paletteer::paletteer_c("oompaBase::greyscale", n=9, direction = -1))
names(cols.tmp) <- c(names(cols.tmp)[1:4], paste0("BP-",seq(2017,2025, by=1)))

PA.NUR |> filter(!validSetBP %in% "ND") |> 
  mutate(TS.def=as.character(fct_recode(param, "BP"="MN","BP"="ND","BP"="SD","BP"="MT"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x=corP, y=TS.def, fill=param))+
  facet_grid(validSetBP ~ trait) +
  facet_grid(validSetBP~trait, scales="fixed")+
  labs(x="Pearson correlation",y="Validation set")+
  geom_col(position=position_dodge(0.9))+
  theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-0.4,0.5,by=0.2))+
  scale_fill_manual(values=cols.tmp, name="Validation set composition")+
  theme(legend.position="none")
ggsave(here("output","figures","GP-acBP-scenarios_predict-by-cohort.png"),
       width=7,height=5,scale=0.85)
```



# Correlation between predicted values for NUR

```{r}
NUR.all <- bind_rows(all.pred$acBP)  |> 
  filter(trainSetBP %in% "NUR") |> 
  rename(validSetBP=BP) |>
  select (-obs, -GP.method, -trainSetBP) |> 
  mutate(scenario="NUR-all")
NUR.BP <- bind_rows(all.pred$nursBP) |> 
  select(-obs, -GP.method) |> mutate(scenario="NUR-BP")
pred.df <- bind_rows(NUR.all, NUR.BP) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from=scenario, values_from=pred) 
pred.df 
pred.df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=`NUR-all`, y=`NUR-BP`))+
  facet_wrap(~trait, scales="free")+
  geom_point(size=0.5, alpha=0.5)+
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, color="grey80", linewidth=0.5)+
  theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE, linewidth=0.5)+
  stat_cor(method="pearson", size=3, aes(label=after_stat(r.label)))+
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank())

```



# Explore ND & NUR-ALL vs. NUR-BP & VSK

## Format obs vs. pred


```{r}
nd <- bind_rows(bind_rows(all.pred$acBP) |> 
  filter(BP %in% "ND", trainSetBP %in% "NUR", trait %in% "VSK") |> 
    mutate(scenario="NUR-ALL"),
  bind_rows(all.pred$nursBP) |> 
    filter(validSetBP %in% "ND", trait %in% "VSK") |> 
    mutate(scenario="NUR-BP")
  )  |> 
  filter(!is.na(obs))
table(nd$scenario) ## should be same

nd.pred.wide <- nd |> 
  select(GID, trait, obs, pred, scenario) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols=c("GID","trait","obs"), names_from=scenario, values_from=pred)

```

## Plot

```{r}
ggplot(nd, aes(x=obs, y=pred, color=scenario))+
  geom_point(size=0.8, alpha=0.5)+
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, color="grey80", linewidth=0.5)+
  theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  labs(x="Observed values", y="Predicted values")+
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE, linewidth=0.5)+
  stat_cor(method="pearson", size=3, aes(label=after_stat(r.label)))+
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank())
ggsave(here("output","figures","GP-obs-vs-pred_ND-NUR-ALL_vs_NUR-BP.png"),width=7,height=5,scale=0.85)

ggplot(nd.pred.wide, aes(x=`NUR-ALL`, y=`NUR-BP`))+
  geom_point(size=0.8, alpha=0.5)+
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, color="grey80", linewidth=0.5)+
  theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE, linewidth=0.5)+
  stat_cor(method="pearson", size=3, aes(label=after_stat(r.label)))+
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank())
```
